description: Startles at loud sounds and quiets or smiles when spoken to.
Makes cooing sounds and has different cries for different needs.
Sounds like 'pa', 'ba', and 'mi'. Laughs and giggles.
Understands words for common items like 'cup', 'shoe', or 'juice'.
Says more words every month. Puts two words together ('more cookie').
Uses 2-3 word sentences to talk about and ask for things.
Tells stories that stay on topic. Communicates easily with other children.
Begins to establish eye contact during feeding or play.
Moves eyes in direction of sounds and notices toys that make noise.
Waves 'bye-bye' and points to objects of interest.
Points to pictures in a book when you name them.
Uses k, g, f, t, d, and n sounds. Uses pronouns like I, you, me.
Speaks without repeating syllables or words most of the time.
Uses sentences that give many details. Says rhyming words.
